item.celestisynth.solar_crystal_armor_bo: When receiving damage, the armor bursts in a circle of flame, dealing fire damage and burning surrounding hostile mobs. Each piece increases the damage of the burst and the duration of the fire.
item.celestisynth.lunar_stone_armor_bonu: When receiving damage, the armor bursts in a wave of violet lunar energy, dealing lunar damage to surrounding hostile mobs. Each piece increases the damage of the burst.
